data.name: Description
data.value: A repository on a drive that is not always attached. BorgStudio finds it by its repository ID, even under another drive letter or mount point.

data.name: PathHint
data.value: Where the repository folder is now. If the drive later gets another letter, BorgStudio searches all drives for it and remembers the new place.

data.name: PathNotAbsolute
data.value: Please enter the full path of the folder.

data.name: EjectHint
data.value: After a scheduled backup or check, BorgStudio ejects the drive – unless something else still uses it.

data.name: NotFound
data.value: The drive with this repository is not attached (last seen at {0}).

data.name: NotFoundUnknownId
data.value: The repository folder {0} was not found – is the drive attached?

data.name: EjectNotExternal
data.value: {0} was not ejected: it is not a removable or external drive.
